newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Pac's Smart delays listing - paper.
newsitem.headline: First Pac's Smart delays listing - paper.

text.p: The listing of Smart Communications Inc, a Philippine affiliate of Hong Kong-listed conglomerate First Pacific Co Ltd, had been put on hold, the South China Morning Post reported on Saturday.

The Philippine listing, originally planned for mid-November, had to be postponed because of the poor state of the stock market and sentiment towards cellular phone business in the Philippines, the newspaper quoted First Pacific managing director Manuel Pangilinan as saying.
It did not give a rescheduled timing for the listing.
Company officials were not immediately available to comment.
Smart is also affiliated with Metro Pacific Corp and Nippon Telegraph and Telephone.
